# Resource Storage Nvme Namespace

Create/Modify/Delete an NVMe namespace resource.

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netapp-ontap_nvme_namespace" "example" {
  cx_profile_name = "cluster4"
  name            = "/vol/tf_acc_volume/ns_tf_acc"
  svm_name        = "tf_acc_svm"
  ostype          = "linux"

  space = {
    size       = 30
    size_unit  = "kb"
    block_size = 4096
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `name` (String) The name of the NVMe namespace.
- `space` (Attributes) The storage space related properties of the NVMe namespace. (see below for nested schema)
- `svm_name` (String) The name of the SVM.

### Optional

- `ostype` (String) The operating system type of the NVMe namespace. Choices: aix, linux, vmware, windows.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the NVMe namespace.

### Nested Schema for `space`

Required:

- `size` (Number) The size of the namespace in bytes.

Optional:

- `block_size` (Number) The block size of the namespace in bytes. Allowed values: 512, 4096.
- `size_unit` (String) Unit for size conversion. Supported values: bytes, b, k, kb, m, mb, g, gb, t, tb, p, pb, e, eb, z, zb, y, yb.
